caption: A jogger comes to a wide puddle on a path, jumps over it, and lands on the far side.

sa.check: A jogger runs along a path toward a wide puddle.
The jogger jumps over the puddle.
The jogger lands on the far side.
The puddle is wide enough to need a jump rather than a step.
The run-up comes first, then the jump, then the landing.

pc.expect: The jogger follows one shallow arc from take-off to landing, the running speed carrying across the puddle.
pc.fail: The jogger rises straight up and comes down on the near side; or hangs in the air; or changes direction in mid-air.

pc.expect: After the peak the jogger comes down and lands on the far side.
pc.fail: The jogger hovers over the puddle; or rises again after starting down; or lands and bounces up high.

pc.expect: The run carries into the jump, and after landing the jogger runs on or stops by taking steps.
pc.fail: The jogger slides forward on landing with feet planted; or is carried backward after landing; or speeds up in mid-air.

pc.expect: The legs swing forward for the landing and bend as the feet take the weight, and the path takes the landing.
pc.fail: The jogger lands stiff as a board; or sinks into the path on landing; or the path ripples under the landing.

pc.expect: One jogger keeps limbs, number and shape, and does not pass through the ground.
pc.fail: A limb stretches, detaches or vanishes; or the jogger passes through the path; or a second figure appears.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The jogger's clothing, the puddle and the path stay the same.
pc.fail: The clothing changes colour; or the puddle moves along the path between frames; or the surroundings rearrange.

note: Biomechanics scene: the jogger is kept because the body is the projectile. Running form is not judged; only the arc and the order of take-off, flight and landing.
